title: PPWR compliance for cosmetics: what to ask your manufacturer
summary: As the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation begins to reshape cosmetics packaging, having a manufacturer that follows the legislation closely is becoming a practical advantage

extraction.key_fact: EU 포장재 규정이 화장품 포장을 바꾸기 시작하면서 규정을 잘 따르는 제조사가 이점이 되고 있다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: As the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation begins to reshape cosmetics packaging, having a manufacturer that follows the legislation closely is becoming a practical advantage
